attr.title: Ashen Sanctum
attr.desc: An isometric action RPG in the spirit of Diablo II. Eight heroes and six acts, from the burning Ashlands to the shattered heavens, with a seventh, the realm of chaos, on the way. Side quests, rivals, merchant caravans, an arena, sets, gems, uniques, Nightmare and Hell, and an endless endgame.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Copy AshenSanctum.sh and the ashensanctum folder into your ports folder.
